title: Concept: tox installs no package
description: tox.ini declares a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through tox.ini (pypi).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
